name: Reckless
description: Takes more risks: brings back more loot, but fails more often.

habits.text: Volunteers before the question is finished.
Jumps the last three steps of every ladder.

name: Distrustful
description: If they don't trust the Operator, they may ignore orders.

habits.text: Sits facing the door. Always.
Counts the supplies twice when nobody's looking.

name: Light feet
description: Their expeditions are shorter.

habits.text: Never makes a sound walking. It's unnerving.
Can't sit still for long.

name: Methodical
description: Thinks before acting. Prefers the safe option.

habits.text: Labels every shelf in the bunker.
Checks gear in the same order every time.

name: Fearful
description: Bad things hit twice as hard. Can appear after a loss.

habits.text: Keeps the radio volume on, even at night.
Jumps at the sound of the door.

name: Loyal
description: Follows the Operator even when things go wrong.

habits.text: Saves the last of anything for someone else.
Waits by the radio when someone's out.

name: Cold-blooded
description: Stress barely touches them.

habits.text: Eats the same way every day. Same pace, same order.
Doesn't flinch at loud noises.

name: Shadow
description: Specialization: moves without being seen.

name: Tracker
description: Specialization: reads the ground and finds more.

name: Marksman
description: Specialization: steady aim when it matters.

name: Mechanic
description: Specialization: can fix anything.

name: First aid
description: Specialization: in the infirmary, everyone else heals much faster.

name: Grudge
description: Since the loss, takes too many risks and carries a lot of anger.

name: At peace
description: Settled an old debt. Stress weighs less.

name: Loner
description: Works better alone. Friction with sociable people.

habits.text: Takes meals in the far corner.
Leaves the room when it gets crowded.

name: Sociable
description: Lifts the mood of whoever works beside them.

habits.text: Knows everyone's favorite food by the second day.
Starts every meal with a toast, even with water.

name: Curious
description: Wants to know what's behind every door. Sharp, but risk-prone.

habits.text: Asks the operator what every switch does.
Brings back useless things from every trip, just to look at them.

name: Stubborn
description: Hard to move. Holds firm under pressure, but ignores orders sooner.

habits.text: Finishes every argument with "we'll see".
Redoes other people's knots.

name: Hothead
description: Quick to act, quick to anger. Clashes with methodical people.

habits.text: Punches the wall, then apologizes to it.
Talks louder when tired.

name: Optimist
description: Always sees a way out. Recovers from bad news faster.

habits.text: Whistles while cleaning.
Calls every bad day "almost over".

name: Gentle
description: Calms the wounded. Better at caring for others.

habits.text: Tucks blankets around whoever falls asleep first.
Speaks softer to the wounded.
